steps.title: Parsed file shape
steps.note: Every parsed file returns ok, kind, text, mime, and error. Callers use kind to decide whether to send text or raw image bytes to the model.

steps.title: Image bypass
steps.note: office-file-parse deliberately does not extract text from images. Images are returned as kind='image' so the multimodal provider can handle them directly.

steps.title: Text extraction dispatch
steps.note: parseFileToText dispatches by extension, reads raw bytes, and converts each Office format to plain text. Errors are returned as ParsedFile objects rather than thrown, keeping RAG pipelines resilient.
